{{Quote|Lord Vader, we are detecting the signatures of several large vessels entering the Kamino system. They lack Imperial transponders and will not reply to our hails.''"<br />"''Excellent. Notify Fleet Commander Touler that it is time.|A signals officer and Darth Vader|<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" />}}
'''Touler''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as [[Fleet Commander/Legends|Fleet Commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Touler was present during the [[assault on Kamino]], an attempt by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to take out the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]] dates itself to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. As [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]] is an adaptation of the same events, it must have also taken place that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> When Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starships]] entered the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] told a [[Unidentified signals officer|signals officer]] to inform Touler that it was time to commence the battle. Though the Empire had its [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] positioned above Kamino, the Rebellion eventually broke through its defenses and was victorious.<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" />

==Behind the scenes==
Touler was mentioned in the [[2010]] novel [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed II'']], written by [[Sean Williams]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" />
